license.intro: We've simplified everything to the limit. By purchasing a track on ProffMusic, you get a lifetime right to use it in your projects. No hidden fees or complicated terms.
license.monetizationDesc: Your videos won't get strikes. You can peacefully enable monetization and earn income from ads.
license.lifetimeDesc: Paid once — used forever. Even if you delete your account or we close down.
license.platformsDesc: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Twitch, YouTube, TV, cinema. No restrictions on platforms.
allowedList: Using in personal and commercial videos.
notAllowedList: Claiming authorship of the music (you are purchasing the right to use it, not the authorship).
Uploading tracks to Content ID systems (this blocks other users).
Reselling music in its original form (on CDs, stock music).
Creating remixes and passing them off as your own original work.
Using in products where the music is the main item (e.g., musical toys without an Extended License).
license.contentId1: ProffMusic guarantees that all tracks in our library are not registered in the Content ID system. This means you will not receive automatic complaints from YouTube.
license.contentId2: However, we strictly prohibit our users from registering their videos with our music in the Content ID system. If you do this, you will violate the rights of other purchasers. Violation of this rule results in license cancellation.
license.questionsDesc: Write to us if your project requires special conditions.

static.aboutIntro: We create sound that breathes, feels and amplifies your stories.
static.noAiDesc: We principlely do not use neural networks for music generation. Every track in our library is written by a live composer, played on real instruments and mixed by a professional sound engineer. We believe that emotions can only be conveyed by a human.
static.safeDesc: No strikes or Content ID. We own the exclusive rights to all music in our catalog. When you purchase a license, you receive an official document that protects your project on YouTube, in film and on TV.
static.philosophy1: In the era of fast-food content, we have chosen a different path. We create music not for algorithms, but for directors, who value details. We know how difficult it is to find a track that doesn't sound like a "stock placeholder".
static.philosophy2: ProffMusic started as a closed community of composers working for the film industry. Today we have opened our archives to all creators. Here you will not find millions of identical tracks. Instead, we offer a carefully curated collection where each piece has its own character.
static.ctaDesc: Listen our collection and verify the quality yourself. Demo versions are available for free.
static.contactsIntro: Do you have any questions about licensing, payment or downloading? Our support team is always available and ready to help.
static.supportDesc: For resolving technical questions and issues with orders. We respond within 24 hours.
static.telegramDesc: Fast communication with a manager for discussing individual conditions or partnership.
static.licenseText: When purchasing music on ProffMusic, you receive a non-exclusive commercial license to use the track in your projects. This includes: monetized YouTube videos, advertising, film/TV, corporate projects. Prohibited: resale of the track as a music file, use in violation of copyright. The license has no expiration date and is perpetual.
static.termsText: By using this website, you agree to the terms of the license agreement and the privacy policy. All materials on the site are protected by copyright.
